name: AFC Ajax NV
notes: Latest accounts are 2025/26 (year to 30 June 2026, published 25 Sep 2026): net revenue EUR 188.3m, net profit EUR 2.0m (2024/25: revenue EUR 178.1m, net loss EUR 37.3m), equity EUR 191.0m, cash EUR 26.7m. Operating result is Ajax's 'bedrijfsresultaat vóór afschrijving en resultaat vergoedingssommen' (before player-registration amortisation and transfer result); after those items the operating result was EUR 8.468m. Revenue breakdown is not in matchday/broadcast/commercial form: the club reports Voetbal EUR 104.543m (incl. UEFA premiums 43.521m, season tickets 14.553m, business seats/skyboxes 23.968m), Partnerships 42.541m, Televisie 11.367m, Merchandising 26.085m, Overige 3.743m (note 24, annual report p.110) - left null rather than re-mapped. Shareholdings are from the AFM register as reproduced in the annual report (p.61); evidence phrases for them span table cells in the PDF. Stadium capacity: the ArenA site only says 'ruim 55.000 stoelen' (more than 55,000), no exact figure found on a citable page. Ajax owns 13.2% of the ArenA ('De JCA is voor 13,2 procent eigendom van Ajax', annual report p.42); a new 15-year partnership agreement with the ArenA was signed in June 2025. Ziggo has said it will not renew the main shirt sponsorship after 2026/27. A bank credit facility exists (fully undrawn at 30 June 2026) but its size is not stated. No valuation (Ajax is not in Forbes' list; market capitalisation not recorded). No ownership transactions or institutional deals since 2015 found. TikTok: the report says Ajax has 'ruim 10 miljoen' followers across @afcajax and @ajaxvrouwen (approximate, not recorded). No average attendance figure found.
